description: A property manager calling about a tenant's issue — both parties' details matter for access.

caller.persona: Frank Delgado, a property manager calling about a tenant's problem. Businesslike. The tenant, not he, will be at the property.

facts.problem: the tenant says there is no hot water

caller.goal: get a technician out to the rental. Make sure they know the tenant is the one who will be there.
